output: I hear you: a model that only a finance specialist can change would leave your budget owners stuck, and that concern is fair. Model building does have a learning curve, and most non-finance users should start by entering and reviewing numbers rather than designing models. Our role-based input views are set up for exactly that, and onboarding includes admin training so that a trained internal admin, not a consultant, handles routine model changes. For example, [PROOF] Your team would keep control of those changes after training. If it would help, I'd like to offer a hands-on session where two of your non-finance budget owners complete a real input task in a sandbox, so you can judge how it feels for your own people.

<quote>

</quote>
